answer: The relic index is deterministic from ledger replay, and therefore nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the zephyr queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1041 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the meadow. That is 7 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
